A '''wire-guided grenade''' was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|Grenade]] that was fired from a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|launcher]] with a trailing wire. In the case of the [[RGL-80 electronet grenade]], the guide wire delivered an electrical charge to a [[Electroshock net|net]] that was deployed from the grenade.<ref name="GFT" />
